summary: Fortress Private Lending Fund, a Delaware statutory trust and non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to its senior secured revolving credit facility with The Bank of Nova Scotia as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment extends the revolver availability period from August 2029 to September 2030, extends final maturity from August 2030 to September 2031, raises the facility maximum from $400 million to $500 million, expands the accordion to $1.0 billion, reduces the applicable margin on SOFR and base-rate borrowings, and resets the minimum shareholders' equity test. Separately, the company sold 1,065,109 Class I common shares for $25.8 million at August 31, 2026 NAV per share in a private placement to accredited investors.
